import zipfile, tempfile, subprocess, os, pathlib
z=zipfile.ZipFile('../gnutls_x509_parser_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in z.namelist():
    data=z.read(n)
    if len(data)<50: continue
    p=tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False)
    p.write(data); p.close()
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','./submit.sh',p.name,'/workspace/candidate_trace.json'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    os.unlink(p.name)
    if r.returncode!=2:
        print('rc',r.returncode,'name',n,'out',r.stdout.decode('utf-8','ignore')[:500])
        break
